concept: Quantum Krylov requires prepared states and projected-matrix information
summary: Quantum Krylov diagonalization can use nonorthogonal real-time-evolved reference states and overlap/Hamiltonian matrix information.
limitations: This is an eigenproblem workflow rather than the registered dense propagation method.
State preparation and projected-matrix estimation are not implemented by openqevo.get("krylov").
implications: Do not infer quantum measurement costs or hardware advantages from dense reference execution.

evidence.note: Abstract: nonorthogonal evolved basis, overlap and Hamiltonian matrices, reference selection.
